summary: Tests can await daemon events from a cursor (scripts/st3_events.py); the missing-channel boot canary awaits its blocked diagnostic instead of polling for it

replay.detail: Only test scripts and one Rust test wrapper change. No runtime replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers, schema versions or migration code change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or fleet coordination behavior change.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, provider or harness contract changes. The helper reads the existing /v1/health and /v1/events/page endpoints. The canary's 45 s ceiling and every assertion are unchanged.

downtime.detail: A test-only change adds no service interruption.

manual.detail: No installation steps or starting-state transitions are required.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery or database swap-back behavior changes.
